teachingQuestion: Why is cryptographic protection inseparable from key lifecycle?
focalInsight: Algorithm selection is only one step; unauthorized key access, lost recovery, weak distribution, or unhandled revocation can invalidate the intended protection.
title: Key lifecycle is part of the cryptographic system
caption: Plan controls and owners from generation through destruction before relying on encryption or signatures.

nodes.label: Protect and store
nodes.detail: Access control and hardware or service boundary

altSummary: A six-step key lifecycle covers generation, protection, authenticated distribution, monitored use, rotation or revocation, and controlled recovery or destruction.
textFallback: Generate keys at approved strength in a trusted environment. Protect and store them with scoped access. Distribute or bind keys through authenticated processes. Monitor use. Rotate or revoke keys after expiry, compromise, or material change. Provide authorized recovery when needed and destroy key material when retention ends.
